findings.title: Potentially exposed administrative user management panel
findings.reason: This endpoint appears to provide administrative user management capabilities while responding with HTTP 200 OK without requiring authentication credentials.
findings.impact: Unauthorized actors could gain visibility into system administration functions or user directories.
findings.solution: Implement mandatory multi-factor authentication, server-side session checks, and role-based access control (RBAC).

findings.title: Potentially exposed administrative system settings page
findings.reason: Global system configuration interface is publicly reachable without an active authenticated session.
findings.impact: Potential exposure of internal configuration parameters and administrative UI state.
findings.solution: Require administrator authentication middleware and restrict access via network IP allowlisting.

findings.title: Unprotected administrative root interface
findings.reason: The main admin entrance path `/admin` returns HTTP 200 without redirecting unauthenticated visitors to a login portal.
findings.impact: Exposes administrative portal layout to anonymous visitors.
findings.solution: Configure server-side authentication redirect to `/login` for unauthenticated requests.

findings.title: Unauthenticated REST API user directory access
findings.reason: The REST endpoint `/api/v1/users` returns HTTP 200 OK without requiring an Authorization Bearer header.
findings.impact: Potential exposure of user metadata or account lists to unauthorized callers.
findings.solution: Enforce API key or JWT token validation headers on all `/api/v1/` user resources.

findings.title: Unprotected account data API route
findings.reason: Financial or account-related API route responds to anonymous GET requests.
findings.impact: Risk of data leakage if account records are exposed without authorization checks.
findings.solution: Validate user ownership (IDOR prevention) and enforce token authentication.

findings.title: Potentially exposed billing invoice endpoint
findings.reason: User invoice page responds with HTTP 200 without checking for active login session.
findings.impact: Potential exposure of sensitive billing documents.
findings.solution: Require session cookie verification before serving invoice content.

findings.title: Exposed internal telemetry and health status
findings.reason: Internal system metrics route `/internal/status` is publicly reachable.
findings.impact: Discloses infrastructure technical details to external observers.
findings.solution: Restrict internal telemetry paths to loopback or private management subnets.

findings.title: Publicly accessible configuration JSON asset
findings.reason: The file `/config/db.json` was located in the public web root.
findings.impact: Could reveal database schema names, port numbers, or system configurations.
findings.solution: Move configuration files outside the public web server document root (`/var/www/html` or `/public`).

findings.title: Robots.txt discloses administrative path locations
findings.reason: The `/robots.txt` file contains Disallow directives listing sensitive paths `/admin` and `/internal`.
findings.impact: Provides a map of sensitive administrative endpoints to curious observers.
findings.solution: Do not rely on robots.txt for security. Ensure all listed disallow paths have robust server authentication.

findings.title: Unrated rate limiting on password recovery form
findings.reason: The password reset page does not display CAPTCHA or anti-automation headers.
findings.impact: Vulnerable to automated email enumeration or spam abuse.
findings.solution: Add rate limiting headers (e.g. `X-RateLimit-Limit`) and reCAPTCHA or Turnstile.

findings.title: Missing account lockout header signals on login portal
findings.impact: Potential for brute-force login attempts against user passwords.
findings.solution: Implement IP rate limiting and progressive account lockouts after failed attempts.

findings.title: Admin metrics API path unauthenticated
findings.reason: Path `/api/v1/admin/metrics` returns HTTP 200 without authentication headers.
findings.impact: Exposes performance metrics and system usage stats.
findings.solution: Enforce RBAC security headers and authorization middleware.
